items.title: Gentlemen Ransomware Hits Canadian Airline
items.summary: The Gentlemen ransomware group claimed an attack on a Canadian airline in September 2026, part of a wave of new victim disclosures this month.

items.title: Rhysida Ransomware Breaches Berlin Senate Network
items.summary: The Rhysida ransomware group attacked Berlin's Senate government network in September 2026, disrupting municipal IT systems.

items.title: LAPSUS$ Resumes Extortion Activity, Teases New Victims
items.summary: LAPSUS$ resumed what it calls "Chapter II" of its extortion campaign in September 2026, teasing disclosure of new corporate victims.

items.title: AUDIT TEAM Extorts Four Organizations Across Three Countries
items.summary: A group calling itself AUDIT TEAM conducted data-extortion attacks against four organizations in South Korea, Germany, and Argentina in September 2026.

items.title: Gentlemen Gang Threatens Veradigm Over Patient Data
items.summary: Healthcare technology firm Veradigm disclosed a patient data breach after the Gentlemen ransomware gang claimed an attack and threatened to leak stolen data if a ransom negotiation didn't begin by September 11, 2026.

items.title: Anubis Ransomware Claims Coca-Cola's Fairlife Subsidiary
items.summary: The Anubis ransomware gang claimed responsibility for a cyberattack on Fairlife, Coca-Cola's dairy subsidiary, and is threatening to publish stolen corporate data unless a ransom is paid.

items.title: ShinyHunters Claims McKesson Breach, Hundreds of Millions of Records
items.summary: Healthcare giant McKesson confirmed a cybersecurity incident discovered August 25, 2026, after ShinyHunters claimed to have stolen hundreds of millions of records spanning PII and PHI; the investigation is in early stages.

items.title: Azure East US Outage Knocks Out ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok
items.summary: A roughly 90-minute Azure East US outage on September 3, 2026 took down ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok simultaneously during UK business hours, underscoring shared cloud-region dependency across major AI services.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Outage Disrupts Exchange, SharePoint, Teams
items.summary: A multi-day Microsoft 365 service disruption beginning around August 31, 2026 was traced to a core authentication configuration issue, affecting Outlook, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Copilot, Teams, Purview, and Defender XDR before recovering above 99% availability.

items.title: CISA Orders Federal Patch of Critical Cisco and Citrix Flaws
items.summary: CISA added actively exploited authentication-bypass flaws in Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (CVE-2026-20079, CVSS 10.0) and Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway (CVE-2026-19490, CVSS 9.3) to its KEV catalog, setting a September 12, 2026 federal patch deadline.

items.title: CISA Adds Seven More Exploited Flaws Tied to Reverse Shells, Crypto Miners
items.summary: CISA added seven newly exploited vulnerabilities to its KEV catalog in September 2026, including CVE-2026-49869, linked to attackers deploying reverse shells and cryptocurrency miners after container-environment discovery.

items.title: PivotC2 RAT Campaign Weaponizes CVE-2025-25249
items.summary: A campaign delivering the Node.js-based PivotC2 remote access trojan has targeted more than 3,000 IP addresses and infected 178 devices by exploiting CVE-2025-25249.

items.title: M 6.5 Earthquake Strikes Near Teluknaga, Indonesia
items.summary: A magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck 126 km NNE of Teluknaga, Indonesia on September 11, 2026, with no tsunami warning issued (USGS green alert).

items.title: FEMA Declares Major Disaster for South Dakota Storms and Flooding
items.summary: FEMA issued a Major Disaster Declaration (FEMA-4938-DR) for South Dakota on September 1, 2026, covering severe storms, straight-line winds, tornadoes, and flooding from late June/early July 2026.

items.title: FEMA Approves Individual Assistance for Hawai'i County
items.summary: A Major Disaster Declaration authorizing FEMA's Individual Assistance program for Hawai'i County was declared September 1, 2026, with registration open through November 1, 2026.

physical.note: No new named hurricane or wildfire events surfaced for the current period beyond the FEMA declarations above; searches skewed toward retrospective 2025/2026 disaster trend coverage.
